integrity: Mathematical deduction from named published theorems with exact integer arithmetic; no field enumeration substitutes for the geometric lemmas. Originality is an explicit synthesis, with residual duplicate-publication risk.
scientific_limitations: Nonexistence only for full split degree-two del Pezzo surfaces over F37. No assertion about nonsplit surfaces, the remaining possible small fields, or an independent audit. The key geometric premises are Kuwata's characteristic-not-two involution criterion, the complex 21-involution bound, and the Dolgachev--Martin tame lift in characteristic 37. The 2005 full PDF could not be retrieved; relevant indexed excerpts were examined.
title: No full split degree-two del Pezzo surface exists over the field with thirty-seven elements
